text:
maria: Observed p95 latency spike ~12% on prod gpu-pool-us-east starting ~2026-03-18T10:14Z. Throughput dropped ~18%. KV cache hit-rate for tenant 'acme-pay' fell 82% -> 28% at the same time. Attaching flameprof/trace links in a bit. Anyone else seeing correlated spikes?

incident-bot: Incident created PERF-2026-042 - latency spike in gpu-pool-us-east. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/perf-spike. Pager duty notified.

dinesh: looking now. sFlow and runtime telemetry show a sudden surge of many short concurrent requests from acme-pay — possible eviction storm on KV cache.

sam: quick kernel trace: selector is choosing tiled/fallback kernels much more often during the window. seq length distribution jumped. snippet: 
```
kernel_select_hist: dense=42%, tiled=58%
avg_seq_len: 136 -> 412
```

kevin: KV telemetry: evictions/sec x6 at spike. Also seeing lots of near-identical but slightly differing prefixes, so cache reuse tanked.

maria: can we throttle acme-pay soft immediately to protect other tenants? propose 60rps and enable cached-prefix-hint FF.

dinesh: on it. Two-pronged: 1) soft throttle acme-pay; 2) if available, route to a non-shared dedicated lane or smaller model variant for 30m. Also recommend capping batch size to limit kernel fallback amplification.

sam: applying packer overrides now: 
```
PATCH /api/pools/gpu-pool-us-east/overrides
{"max_batch": 8, "batching_window_ms": 30}
```
Will monitor kernel selection after change.

ops-bot: Feature flag toggle: cached-prefix-hint ON for tenant acme-pay (ff/cache-hint/v2). Rollout 100% by ops-bot.

kevin: after batching + FF, KV hit-rate climbed to ~65% within 3m; p95 down ~5% but not fully back to baseline. throughput recovering.

maria: good. Sam, also apply a short-term request-rate throttle: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/prod/throttle 
 -d '{"tenant":"acme-pay","limit_rps":60,"duration_mins":30}'
```

sam: throttle applied. Confirmed with rate-limiter: acme-pay capped at 60rps.

dinesh: filing follow-up ticket for runbook changes: PERF-2026-042A — prefetch heuristics for stable long prefixes, cache window tuning, and kernel-selector backoff when KV hit-rate < 40%. Adding benchmarks.

sam: saved flameprof + kernel traces: s3://perf/2026/1823456789/flame.svg and s3://perf/2026/1823456789/kernel-trace.log. Recommendation: next-week kernel-selector update to prefer dense kernel when seq-length variance < threshold and add adaptive backoff if KV hit-rate low.

kevin: tenant declined move to dedicated lane (they require shared). So current mitigation = throttles + FF + batching caps.

maria: thanks all. Keep monitoring for 30m stable window before closing. Will update incident doc with mitigation steps and TL;DR for oncall. :thumbsup:

sam: ack, leaving monitoring for 45m and will escalate if p95 rises >8% over current.

dinesh: adding runbook bullet points now and assigning to eng-runtime backlog.

maria: closing loop once stable. Good work.
